definitions.gloss: assistant homeroom teacher; sub-homeroom teacher; deputy class teacher
definitions.explanation: A teacher assigned to assist the main homeroom teacher ({担任|たんにん}) in managing a class. Common in Japanese schools, particularly in elementary and middle school, where the assistant provides additional support for students and classroom activities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧B⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副担任|ふくたんにん}だ。
examples.english: Mr. Tanaka is the assistant homeroom teacher of class 3-B.

examples.japanese: ⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副担任|ふくたんにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: When the homeroom teacher is absent, the assistant homeroom teacher looks after the class.

examples.japanese: {新任|しんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{副担任|ふくたんにん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んで→積む：02294_tsumu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}される⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: New teachers often first gain experience as an assistant homeroom teacher before being given their own class.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ ('vice-; assistant; deputy') and ⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧ ('homeroom teacher; person in charge'). Reflects the Japanese school system where each class has a primary homeroom teacher and often a supporting one.

USAGE:
- The ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ prefix follows the same pattern as {副社長|ふくしゃちょう} ('vice president'), ⟦{副会長|ふくかいちょう}→副会長：20469_fukukaichou⟧ ('vice chairperson')
- In practice, the {副担任|ふくたんにん} often teaches a specific subject while also assisting with homeroom duties
- More common in middle and high schools; some elementary schools also use this system

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副担任|ふくたんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as assistant homeroom teacher
- {副担任|ふくたんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: the assistant homeroom teacher
- {副担任|ふくたんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}される: to be assigned as assistant homeroom teacher
- ⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{副担任|ふくたんにん}: homeroom teacher and assistant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧: homeroom teacher — the main class teacher responsible for the students
- {学年主任|がくねんしゅにん}: grade-level head teacher — the teacher overseeing an entire grade
- {教科担任|きょうかたんにん}: subject teacher — a teacher assigned to teach a specific subject across multiple classes
